model.label: YOLO11n
model.size_rule: bytes = sum over the quantizable conv weights of params * bits / 8, bits = b + 16/K for intb (one fp16 scale per output channel, K = in_channels/groups*kh*kw) and 16 for fp16, plus every other parameter and buffer of the fused deployed model (conv biases with BatchNorm folded in, the fixed DFL conv weight) at 2 bytes; original = every parameter and buffer at 2 bytes (FP16 file). Rounded up to whole bytes. Excluded: file headers, the model graph, class names

quantization: weight-only fake-quant: symmetric per-output-channel absmax, RNE, fp16 scale; activations FP32
objective: D = mean over the 128 calibration images of sum_a w_a*(||p_q - p||^2 + ||b_q - b||^2 / 640^2) / sum_a w_a, where y = [B, 84, A] is the fused model's raw head output (b = 4 box coordinates in letterbox pixels, p = 80 sigmoid class probabilities) of the unquantized model and y_q of the quantized one, w_a = max_c p_a (native). Table: one conv quantized at a time; the knapsack sums D over layers (additive assumption), the measured D quantizes every layer of a setup at once

calibration.preprocess: fixed 640x640 letterbox: long side resized to 640 (ceil, cv2 INTER_LINEAR, no upscaling), Ultralytics LetterBox centre pad 114, BGR->RGB, /255, batches of 32

evaluation.rule: the 4872 val2017 ids not in calibration.ids (the demo images are included); inference runs on all 5000 in the evaluator's rect batch plan (batch 8) and pycocotools scores only these ids
evaluation.metric: COCO bbox AP50-95 / AP50 / AP75 / AP small · medium · large (pycocotools, one run)
